As a Mentor, I want to review and annotate opportunities and pilot evidence so I can guide entrepreneurs.

Acceptance criteria:
- Inline annotation UI for evidence items.
- Ratings and recommendation flags stored and visible to pilot owners.
- Milestone sign-off action with timestamp and mentor id.
